verdict.rationale: Cooley GO is a web-based document generator, and Cooley AI is a firm-owned AI offering, so a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for this kind of product. However, no evidence shows any API or spec, and probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths on cooleygo.com all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
